_comment: SINGLE SOURCE for kernel C signatures, consumed by vector_check.py to generate a driver per kernel. Adding a kernel means adding an entry here, not writing a new driver. Buffers are initialised from a byte-hex blob via memcpy so element width and signedness are handled uniformly and host byte order is used consistently on both sides of every comparison.
_dir: in = read-only input buffer; out = buffer the kernel writes and the vector pins; scalar return is compared directly.
_hex: field name in the vector record holding this buffer's bytes, little-endian host order for multi-byte element types.

sat_add_u8.signature: void sat_add_u8(const uint8_t *a, const uint8_t *b, uint8_t *out, size_t n)

fir_q15.signature: void fir_q15(const int16_t x[256], const int16_t h[16], int16_t y[256])

matmul8_i32.signature: void matmul8_i32(const int32_t a[64], const int32_t b[64], int32_t c[64])

median3x3_u8.signature: void median3x3_u8(const uint8_t in[16*16], uint8_t out[14*14])
